capabilities.basis: The extension ships a browser-based user-facing interface (its popup page) that people operate directly, which is the canonical web-interface definition at the pinned baseline.

notDeclared.mobile-app: No installable application for a mobile operating system is shipped. A possible future mobile client is not a current project fact.
notDeclared.operated-service: No deployed, network-reachable service exists; the extension has no backend.

baselineIdentity.pinnedBy: Universal Project Bootstrap main d3efc7c5d1d99b20f6691c8242fc2892e530c176 (src/source.mjs). The frozen bootstrap-v1 tag predates this pin and is not used.
baselineIdentity.adoptionNote: The baseline is adopted only by a completed Bootstrap Apply. Until then no consumer bundle, lock or verifier exists in this repository and no conformance claim is made.

localGaps.gap: The canonical baseline has no browser-extension permission or privacy rule; SEC-004 is conditional on mobile-app and does not apply.
localGaps.handling: Project-local controls recorded in this repository: minimal permissions with a stated reason for each, local-only processing, no remote code, no telemetry, preferences-only storage, and a runtime network check. The canonical standards are not expanded.
